summary.content:
Today's selection covers 38 articles from 7 trusted sources, including 26 on Artificial Intelligence and 7 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Decades-Old Squid Proxy Flaw ‘Squidbleed’ Can Expose User Data
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from Google, Anthropic, Microsoft
• **Security Alert**: What the Latest ShinyHunters Breaches Reveal About Modern Cyberattacks
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from SecurityWeek, TechCrunch, NY Times Tech, Dark Reading, BleepingComputer and others
• **Fresh Content**: 19 articles published in the last 24 hours
